resources.summary: The 2017 development study reports 29 items, five response categories and three dimensions, transcendence, harmony with nature and anomie. Overall internal consistency is reported as .886. This instrument is not a Turkish translation of the 20-item Paloutzian and Ellison SWBS. The abstract reports SRMR .50, while Table 6 gives .050 on page 84. MARSAM records this unresolved source discrepancy rather than silently correcting it. Exploratory and confirmatory analyses use the same data. Independent validation, cross-group measurement invariance and clinical cut-offs are not established by this record.

resources.summary: Twenty items use six response categories to assess religious and existential wellbeing. Each subscale has ten items. The religious domain includes a relationship with God. This is a different instrument from the 29-item Ekşi and Kardaş scale. The author hosts a Turkish form dated 2022. Availability of a translation does not establish Turkish psychometric validity or measurement invariance, neither of which is verified here. No-cost use requires proper citation and retention of the copyright byline. MARSAM does not republish items or the scoring form. The two SWBS scores must not be assumed equivalent.
